confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge and the city context, not from live booking pages or current listings. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately reliable. Hotel and hostel anchors are less certain because Delhi prices vary widely by neighbourhood, season, and taxes. Cocktail and wine_glass use the local price relationship to draft beer (bar drinks roughly 2.5 to 3 times the beer price after taxes) because direct knowledge is weaker. FX: the 0.6955 value was taken from search-result summaries attributed to the RBA exchange rates page. I did not open the rba.gov.au page myself, so the server should verify it before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on the South Asia regional pattern for large Indian metropolitan tourist centres, with Delhi-specific adjustments for restaurant, hostel, and hotel prices. July is monsoon season, so accommodation demand is usually softer than in winter.
